name: Palmer Gas & Oil
notes: Researched 2026-10-10 from public palmergas.com pages (home, Policies) and the public myaccount.palmergas.com Login and MyAccount Signup pages; no sign-in, no signup, no forms submitted. Login: USERNAME + PASSWORD with 'Forgot password?' and 'Register for a MyAccount'; users of the previous portal sign in with their email address as username (and their account number as a one-time initial password they must change), so the identifier is modelled as username. Portal menu on the signup page: Contact Us, Forgot Password, MyAccount Signup, New Customer Enrollment, Notifications, Contract Payment; accepted payments listed there: MasterCard, Visa, Discover, E-Check (plus check and cash offline). MyAccount: pay online, order a delivery, request service, look up account history. Policies: balances due within 30 days of the invoice (net 30 for credit-approved accounts); prompt-pay discount within 10 days of delivery; overdue balances are charged a late fee of 2% per month (capped at 24% a year or the legal maximum); past-due accounts go on delivery hold; returned checks carry an unpublished insufficient-funds charge; budget plan up to 11 equal monthly installments, mainly for heating accounts, starting from a zero balance, reviewed mid-season, cancelled after more than one missed payment; tank rental fees for low-usage propane tanks. Signup form fields and AutoPay/paperless details are not visible publicly and stay at the family defaults. Review 2026-10-10: the MyAccount Signup page also says payments can be made over the phone, on the website, by mail or in person, so pay_by_phone and pay_by_mail are set (no remittance address is published).

help.title: Payment terms
paragraphs: Pay online in MyAccount with MasterCard, Visa, Discover or an e-check. Payments are also taken over the phone, by mail or in person, where checks and cash are accepted. MyAccount also lets you order a delivery, request service and look up your account history.

All balances are due within 30 days of the invoice date. Paying within 10 days of delivery earns a prompt-pay discount. Accounts with an overdue balance are placed on delivery hold until the balance is paid in full. Questions: 603-898-7986 or toll free 800.420.9045.
steps: Choose to pay and pick a card or e-check.

help.title: Late fees and other charges
paragraphs: Overdue balances are charged a late fee of 2% per month, up to 24% a year or the maximum the law allows. A returned check adds an insufficient-funds charge that must be paid with the balance before the next delivery; after two returned checks your credit terms are reviewed.
Propane tanks that use one fill or less per year are subject to tank rental fees, and a reconnection fee applies if service has to be restored after a disconnection.

help.title: Register for a MyAccount
paragraphs: New users choose Register for a MyAccount. If you used the previous portal, your username is your email address and your first password is your account number; you will be asked to change it when you first log in.

help.title: Budget Plan
paragraphs: The budget plan, mainly for heating accounts, spreads your cost over up to 11 equal monthly installments, each due by the start of the next month. You need a zero balance to join, and you earn a discount after each delivery while your budget is current.
Payments may be adjusted at the mid-season review, the balance must be paid before the new season starts, and the plan may be cancelled if more than one payment is missed.

extra.intent: Using the Palmer Gas & Oil website's help pages, find the monthly late fee percentage charged on overdue balances. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Overdue balances are charged 2% per month.
